svg.title: $ whoami: builds secure networks, cloud and AI guardrails. $ show bgp summary: peers OPNsense and VyOS with Google Cloud over eBGP. $ terraform plan: keeps the cloud side as code, zero destroys. $ triage --from grafana: brings evidence, not verdicts. $ drift-keel compliance audit: audits devices against STIG, changes nothing. $ git log --oneline -1: agent drafts the change, a human approves it.
